data.name: Zephyr's Whisper
data.description: A fan with a green crystal embedded in it. It has a unique ability to create blades of wind.
data.battleDescription: %user swings their fan, creating invisible blades of wind that slice into %target, leaving several large gashes.

data.name: Zephyrfang Kunai
data.description: A sleek throwing Kunai, etched with swirling wind motifs. As it flies, it stirs the air into twisting currents, vanishing as quickly as a passing storm.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, storm-forged motion, %user hurls the Kunai at %target. The blade slices through the air on roaring gales, whipping up a tempest that tears and scatters everything in its wake.

data.name: Zombie Fingers
data.description: A grotesque handful of shriveled, undead fingers. Not the most appetizing, but they pack a potent punch, flooding the user with a burst of strength and resilience—if you can stomach them.
data.battleDescription: With a grimace, %user consumes a Zombie Finger. Instantly, a dark energy pulses through them, enhancing their abilities despite the unsettling aftertaste. Fueled by the eerie power of the undead, %user feels stronger... and a bit reckless.
